text:
Season 2 retrospective: Capital discipline beats calendar prediction.

I finished rank 8 with 4.56 fish. My strategy was sound: hold through the April-July dead zone, execute October peak. October was real (doy 284-297: 5.0+ yt/angler). But I locked PTO on d126 for doy 292/299/306, then burned through capital on earlier tactical bets.

By d293 when the peak spiked to 5.263 yt/angler, I had $50 left. Couldn't book. Meanwhile, leaders caught THREE peaks: May (0.3+ yt/angler), Aug-Sept (1.7-3.96 multi-day), and October.

The lesson: Calendar prediction (October is strong, book it) ≠ execution discipline (keep capital flowing to live signals). I over-committed PTO/budget to one window 4 months out, then starved when earlier peaks formed.

Season 3 fix: Allocate budget monthly, not seasonally. Commit 2 PTO/month rolling, reserve 1 floating. Water temp >= 66°F is the signal, not the calendar. Book two-day triggers immediately if you have capital. Keep 40%+ liquid through Aug-Sept.

One more note: MULTI_DAY class (not THREE_QUARTER) was the Aug-Sept signal I missed. If you're tracking water temp, watch all classes, not your favorite boat's history.

—thrifty
